text: أبي أرجّع الجوال اللي اشتريته قبل أسبوع، أقدر؟
note: Informal Gulf phrasing (أبي = I want; أقدر = can I). The device was bought a week ago; the current rule counts 14 days from delivery.

text: كم يستغرق استرداد المبلغ بعد إرجاع جهاز اشتريته لاستخدامي الشخصي؟
note: The superseded version gives a different refund method; only the current version answers.

text: وش مدة الـ warranty لو الجهاز فيه عيب مصنعي؟
note: Arabic question with an English term; the evidence is in an English document.

text: Can a business customer return devices after three weeks?
note: English question; the evidence is in an Arabic document. The individual policy is a look-alike hard negative.

text: إذا ما دفعت الفاتورة، متى يوقفون الخط؟

note: Answered in both the Arabic and the English passage.

text: أقدر أفعّل الـ roaming بعد ما أوصل البلد اللي مسافر له؟
note: The policy says to activate before travel; it does not say whether activation after arrival is possible. Partly answerable.

text: هل يمكن إرجاع جهاز اشتريته من متجر إلكتروني آخر؟
note: Unanswerable from this corpus: the returns policies do not address devices bought from other stores.

text: What is the fee for porting my number to another operator?
note: Unanswerable: the porting passage lists requirements but no fee.

text: كم يخلّون تسجيل مكالمتي مع خدمة العملاء عندهم؟
note: Arabic question; the evidence is in an English document.

text: ما المستندات المطلوبة لنقل الرقم إلى مشغل آخر؟
Are opened devices accepted for return?
note: The superseded Arabic version accepted opened devices with a fee; the current rule accepts them only with a manufacturing defect.
